title: Trump Hosts Artemis II Crew at White House in First Presidential Reception for Lunar Astronauts Since Apollo Era
detail: President Trump welcomed Commander Reid Wiseman, Pilot Victor Glover, Mission Specialist Christina Koch, and Mission Specialist Jeremy Hansen to the White House following their historic Moon flyby — marking the first presidential reception for a crewed lunar mission team since the Apollo era. The ceremony recognized the Artemis II crew's April 1–10 mission, humanity's first crewed journey to the Moon's vicinity since Apollo 17 in 1972.

media.caption: President Trump welcomes the Artemis II crew at the White House on May 1, 2026 — the first presidential reception for a lunar crew since the Apollo era.
